string.name: name
string.value: EXP Booster 11pack (4hr)

string.name: desc
string.value: This item will cause your character to receive 150% EXP for 4 hours. This boost will stack with other EXP boosting effects. Double click on this item in the cash tab in your inventory and it will give you #c11 EXP present boxes in your use tab#. Activate an EXP present box in your inventory to start the receiving the boost. Note: does not work on Quests and PVP. #cThis item is only available for purchase if you are level 200 or below.#
